item.title: Chan v1.2.9
item.description:
Chan 1.2.9 | Chance
## New Features
- New captcha cloud solver - Small redesign of captcha form - Support image pasting from keyboard on iOS 27 - Rename saved attachments
## General Improvements
- Reddit comments replaced by "Edit: comment has been cleaned" will retain their previous text - Many QUIC and HTTP/3 bugfixes and performance improvements
## Tweaks
- Don't insert duplicate quotelinks when using "reply" to open the reply form - Added a confirmation before clearing cookies when banned - Hide archive name when scrolling to bottom of thread (it's already there) - Always restart videos from beginning in gallery - Slight tweak of tab bar resizing for long tab titles
## Bugfixes
- Threads not marked as archived - Gallery changed image when rotating the device - Compatibility error on some newer Android versions - Unable to tap tabs on first page sometimes - Intermittent errors about directories not existing - YouTube shorts embeds not shown - Posting multiple files on lynxchan-based sites didn't work and just combined their filenames - Thread tail requests were not properly optimized for caching - Cloudflare popup trying to load Twitter embed data - Backspacing an embeddable URL in the reply box would cause repeated network requests - Tab bar spazzed open and close when slowly scrolling to the bottom of a thread
